# RVBBIT

> RVBBIT is the open-source Postgres extension inside Calliope: semantic operators in plain SQL (means, classify, knn_text, semantic_case, triples_rows, synth_sql), MCP calls (mcp_call, mcp_rows, register_mcp_server), metrics and alerts, columnar acceleration, and receipts for model-backed answers. Calliope 1.2.1 is self-hosted. Clover is the local Hutch model gateway in that install, backed by your OpenRouter key. There is no Clover account, free tier, or paid subscription.

## Setup

- [Calliope install](https://usecalliope.com): `curl -fsSL https://usecalliope.com/install.sh | bash` (read it first; Linux x86-64, Docker Compose 2.30+)
- [Quickstart](https://rvbbit.ai/docs/quickstart): what that install gives you, then the first SQL
- [Setup for Agents](https://rvbbit.ai/agents.md): the same path, written for agents
- [install.sh on this site](https://rvbbit.ai/install.sh): prints the move. It does not install the old stack and it does not run the Calliope installer
- [Clover, self-hosted](https://rvbbit.ai/clover): Hutch, OpenRouter-backed operators, optional GLiNER and TSPulse, your own MCP servers and operators

## Reference

- [Docs index](https://rvbbit.ai/docs)
- [MCP from SQL](https://rvbbit.ai/docs/mcp)
- [Semantic SQL](https://rvbbit.ai/docs/semantic-sql)
- [Existing Postgres](https://rvbbit.ai/docs/existing-postgres): no published extension tarball; build `crates/pg_rvbbit` from the Calliope repo, or use the Calliope Postgres image
- [Capability catalog (JSON)](https://rvbbit.ai/catalog.json): operator names that ship with the engine. It is not a checkout catalog
- [Benchmarks](https://rvbbit.ai/benchmarks): older standalone-engine snapshot, not a Calliope 1.2.1 run
- Engine source: https://github.com/ryrobes/calliope/tree/main/crates/pg_rvbbit

## Optional

- [Data Rabbit](https://rvbbit.ai/docs/data-rabbit): the SQL desktop inside Calliope (`calliope-datarabbit`), also described at https://datarabbit.com
